The backend calls this method to emit a report while processing an advance-state or inspect-state request.
A report is information for the client, such as a log, an error or the result of an inspect. It cannot be validated on the base layer.
Reports of advance-state requests are kept even when the input is rejected, and the node serves them through its JSON-RPC API. Reports of inspect-state requests are returned in the inspect response only.
